name: shul-crm
description: Shul CRM — monorepo (api + web + shared); reference install: Pilzno

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @shulcrm/api" "npm run dev -w @shulcrm/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @shulcrm/api && npm run build -w @shulcrm/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @shulcrm/api && npm run typecheck -w @shulcrm/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @shulcrm/api && npm run lint -w @shulcrm/web
